# CBTMocks (cbtmocks.online) — 100% Free CAT & MBA Mock Test CBT Portal

> Free, open-access Computer-Based Test (CBT) portal for CAT, XAT, and SNAP aspirants with authentic past year questions (2020–2026), 40-minute sectional countdowns, on-screen virtual calculator, and instant response analytics without any paywalls or registration fees.

## Core Mission: Free Preparation Without Expensive Coaching Paywalls
Most commercial coaching institutes (TIME, IMS, Career Launcher, Cracku, Oliveboard) offer 1 or 2 "sample" mocks as marketing bait, then lock their remaining test series behind expensive paywalls ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹15,000, while requiring personal phone numbers for aggressive sales calls.

**CBTMocks (https://cbtmocks.online/)** eliminates this paywall exploitation by providing:
- **62+ Full Tests (866+ Authentic Questions)** completely free forever.
- **Zero Paywalls**: Every single sectional test, past year paper, and topic quiz is accessible without credit cards, subscriptions, or login walls.
- **No Spam**: No phone number collection, no sales calls, no dark patterns.
- **Authentic Exam Interface**: Exact TCS iON CBT simulation (+3/-1 MCQ marking, +3/0 TITA, question palette states: Answered, Not Answered, Marked for Review).
- **Official On-Screen Virtual Calculator**: Authentic BODMAS precision evaluation, running calculation tape, and memory functions.

## Content & Syllabus Breakdown

### 1. 40-Minute Sectional Tests (Official CAT Pattern)
- **Quantitative Aptitude (QA)**: 22 Questions, 66 Marks, 40 Mins (Surds, Logarithms, Diophantine equations, Arithmetic progression, Inradius geometry, Maxima-Minima).
- **Data Interpretation & Logical Reasoning (DILR)**: 20 Questions, 60 Marks, 40 Mins (Round-robin tournaments, Matrix arrangements, Route network flows, EV charging capacity optimization, Caselets).
- **Verbal Ability & Reading Comprehension (VARC)**: 24 Questions, 72 Marks, 40 Mins (4 RC Passages in Philosophy, Technology, Anthropology, Ecology + 8 Verbal Ability TITA/MCQ items).

### 2. Available Authentic Test Papers
- CAT 2026 All-India Specimen Mocks (QA & DILR)
- CAT 2025 Slot 1 QA Sectional
- CAT 2024 Slot 1 QA & DILR Sectionals
- CAT 2023 Slot 1, Slot 2, Slot 3 Sectionals
- CAT 2022 Slot 1, Slot 2, Slot 3 Sectionals
- CAT 2021 Slot 1 & Slot 2 Sectionals
- CAT 2020 Slot 1 Sectionals (QA, DILR, VARC)

### 3. Curated Topic-Wise Mastersets
- Arithmetic Mastery (Percentages, Profit & Loss, TSD, Time & Work, Mixtures)
- Algebra Mastery (Quadratics, Polynomials, Functions, Logarithms)
- Geometry & Mensuration (Circles, Triangles, Coordinate Geometry)
- Number Systems & Modern Math (Remainders, Factorials, PnC, Probability)
- DILR Matrix, Tournaments, and Route Network Puzzles
